    Source: DLP, RTL and LIS inventory variance sheets in your workbook. Cut-off dates differ by warehouse (DLP Mar 28, RTL Mar 31, LIS Apr 1, 2025). Variance is count minus system on-hand, valued at landed cost; totals match the SUMMARY sheet (net –$188,897). Item lists and size bands include variances of $1 or more; every total includes all items. An item with a count of 0 shows as a full shortage, so confirm it was actually counted before treating it as loss.
